regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your appreciated favor duly received and noted. May our dear Lord bless you and yours and give you His holy peace! We shall always deem it a privilege to comply with such requests. We hope that our efforts will be satis- factory. How wonderful, in the promotion of mu- tual and common charity, that - next to our happy dependence on Almighty God Himself - He has made us mutually dependent also on one another. And incidentally, what a marvellously different so- ciety we'd have here, and what an ideal world to live in if we'd all keep in mind the assurance of Jesus, "What you have done to the least of my brethren you have done to me."
